name: Bola Wing Pin (Combat)
body:
You are able to ground flying creatures, pinning their wings down with your bolas.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with bolas, Bola Adept, Entangling Bolas

Benefit(s): You can make a ranged trip attempt against flying creatures with wings. If successful, they stall and are unable to fly until they spend a standard action to remove the bolas.
